Listing compressed files

Each compressor has a listing option. gzip -l prints the sizes and the
ratio under this header:

         compressed        uncompressed  ratio uncompressed_name
                 42                  12 -16.7% hello.txt

xz -l prints one row per file, with the check type in its own column:

Strms  Blocks   Compressed Uncompressed  Ratio  Check   Filename
    1       1         76 B         12 B  6.333  CRC64   hello.txt.xz

zstd -l prints much the same, with the banner on standard error:

Frames  Skips  Compressed  Uncompressed  Ratio  Check  Filename
     1      0      25   B        12   B  0.480  XXH64  hello.txt.zst

and lz4 --list prints dashes where the frame does not state its size:

    Frames           Type Block  Compressed  Uncompressed    Ratio   Filename
         1       LZ4Frame   B4I       31.00             -        -   hello.txt.lz4

With --robot, xz prints tab separated lines that open with a word:

name	hello.txt.xz
file	1	1	76	12	6.333	CRC64	0

None of these is a format a shell script should parse by column
position; use the robot form or a tool that reads the listing.
